adaptation: CommonJS modules converted to ESM with named exports.
Filesystem helpers dropped from the format core: readSkillFile, scanSkillRoot and resolveInstalled are gone, so the port has no dependency on the HNS installation directory.
extractTar was not carried over: this module inspects archives in memory and never writes files, which removes the extraction path entirely.
readSkillFile's size guard was folded into parseSkillText so a pasted document is bounded by the same MAX_SKILL_BYTES rule.
Archive inspection reports accepted/refused entries instead of returning a written-files list.
The source scanner reads through an injectable adapter (isDirectory / isFile / list) instead of node:fs directly, so the same tiered scan runs over the real disk and over an in-memory tree in tests.
GitHub resolution stays a plan: archive URL forms, ref splits and subpaths are produced as data, and the module has no fetch, request or download entry point.
The catalog's live GitHub code search takes an injectable fetchJson; without one it answers 'unavailable' and the curated and bundled entries stand.
describeRef was moved out of the incubator room wiring into source.mjs, because it only describes a parsed reference.
knownDifferences: No skill installation: this module validates, inspects and discovers; it never writes a skill to disk.
readEntries filters unsafe paths out of the entry list (donor behaviour) instead of surfacing them as refused entries.
No GitHub download happens here: resolutionPlan returns the attempts a caller could make, and the module never performs one.
The donor's skill-service.js is out of scope: nothing here installs, updates or removes a skill.

vectors: skill name grammar (valid and invalid sets)
frontmatter subset: whenToUse, metadata, invocation booleans (all accepted spellings)
tar listing of regular files and directories with stripComponents
path traversal and absolute path refusal
GitHub reference forms: owner/repo, @ref, subpath, /tree/, /blob/, raw and plain URLs
resolution plan ordering for repository, tree and raw references
tiered scanner order: subpath, own bundle, skills/ collection, sibling bundles, flat files
scaffolding directories are never offered as skills
catalog ranking: a name hit outranks a summary hit, tags filter with AND
a failed or unconfigured live search never removes the offline answer
